1.bug_scenario: The bug involves a ComboBox component that does not dismiss other open ComboBox or DropDown components when a new ComboBox is opened. This issue is specific to the ComboBox component in the `carbon-components-react` package. The expected behavior is that opening a new ComboBox should close any other open ComboBox or DropDown. The issue occurs in both Chrome and Firefox and is present in version 10.37.0 of the Carbon Design System, whereas it was working correctly in version 10.23.2.
